diagnosis_uniqueness: The optimum before the final station-id tie breaker MUST contain exactly one station; the station-id item only fixes serialization order.
stable_event: A source_id/origin_us pair with exact implied-origin agreement at at least min_stable_stations distinct non-excluded stations. At most one pick per station is selected, by pick_id.

residual_lattice.nodes: Every faulty pick/event pair whose residual lies in [residual_min_us,residual_max_us].
residual_lattice.path: Assignments are one-to-one and strictly increasing in both (true_arrival_us,event_id) and (recorded_us,pick_id).
residual_lattice.uniqueness: The optimum before lexicographic serialization tie breakers MUST be unique.

clock_model.boundary_rule: A segment starts at campaign_start_us or an allowed boundary. A true arrival equal to a boundary belongs to the segment starting there.
clock_model.rate: rate_num/rate_den is positive, reduced, and listed in campaign.toml.
clock_model.jump: offset_us is independent at each segment start.

reconciliation.accepted_faulty: The fitted model maps origin_us plus travel_us exactly to recorded_us.

json.jsonl: One compact sort-key-ordered JSON object per LF-terminated line.
